verse.unicode: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ

transliteration.english: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ghar doojaa asaTapadheeaa

en.bdb: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla, Second House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

verse.unicode: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥

transliteration.english: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||

en.bdb: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verse.unicode: ਪਾਠੁ ਪੜਿਓ ਅਰੁ ਬੇਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਨਿਵਲਿ ਭੁਅੰਗਮ ਸਾਧੇ ॥

transliteration.english: paaTh paRio ar bedh beechaario nival bhua(n)gam saadhe ||

en.bdb: They read scriptures, and contemplate the Vedas; they practice the inner cleansing techniques of Yoga, and control of the breath.

verse.unicode: ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਛੁਟਕਿਓ ਅਧਿਕ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਬਾਧੇ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: pa(n)ch janaa siau sa(n)g na chhuTakio adhik aha(n)budh baadhe ||1||

en.bdb: But they cannot escape from the company of the five passions; they are increasingly bound to egotism. ||1||

verse.unicode: ਪਿਆਰੇ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਮੈ ਕੀਏ ਕਰਮ ਅਨੇਕਾ ॥

transliteration.english: piaare in bidh milan na jaiee mai ke'ee karam anekaa ||

en.bdb: O Beloved, this is not the way to meet the Lord; I have performed these rituals so many times.

verse.unicode: ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਦੀਜੈ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

transliteration.english: haar pario suaamee kai dhuaarai dheejai budh bibekaa || rahaau ||

en.bdb: I have collapsed, exhausted, at the Door of my Lord Master; I pray that He may grant me a discerning intellect. ||Pause||

verse.unicode: ਮੋਨਿ ਭਇਓ ਕਰਪਾਤੀ ਰਹਿਓ ਨਗਨ ਫਿਰਿਓ ਬਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥

transliteration.english: mon bhio karapaatee rahio nagan firio ban maahee ||

en.bdb: One may remain silent and use his hands as begging bowls, and wander naked in the forest.

verse.unicode: ਤਟ ਤੀਰਥ ਸਭ ਧਰਤੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਛੁਟਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥

transliteration.english: taT teerath sabh dharatee bhramio dhubidhaa chhuTakai naahee ||2||

en.bdb: He may make pilgrimages to river banks and sacred shrines all over the world, but his sense of duality will not leave him. ||2||

verse.unicode: ਮਨ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਤੀਰਥ ਜਾਇ ਬਸਿਓ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਵਤ ਧਰਾਏ ॥

transliteration.english: man kaamanaa teerath jai basio sir karavat dharaae ||

en.bdb: His mind's desires may lead him to go and dwell at sacred places of pilgrimage, and offer his head to be sawn off;

verse.unicode: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਜੇ ਲਖ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਾਏ ॥੩॥

transliteration.english: man kee mail na utarai ieh bidh je lakh jatan karaae ||3||

en.bdb: but this will not cause the filth of his mind to depart, even though he may make thousands of efforts. ||3||

verse.unicode: ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਿਨੀ ਹੈਵਰ ਗੈਵਰ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥

transliteration.english: kanik kaaminee haivar gaivar bahu bidh dhaan dhaataaraa ||

en.bdb: He may give gifts of all sorts - gold, women, horses and elephants.

verse.unicode: ਅੰਨ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਭੂਮਿ ਬਹੁ ਅਰਪੇ ਨਹ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੪॥

transliteration.english: a(n)n basatr bhoom bahu arape neh mileeaai har dhuaaraa ||4||

en.bdb: He may make offerings of corn, clothes and land in abundance, but this will not lead him to the Lord's Door. ||4||

verse.unicode: ਪੂਜਾ ਅਰਚਾ ਬੰਦਨ ਡੰਡਉਤ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਰਤੁ ਰਹਤਾ ॥

transliteration.english: poojaa arachaa ba(n)dhan dda(n)ddaut khaT karamaa rat rahataa ||

en.bdb: He may remain devoted to worship and adoration, bowing his forehead to the floor, practicing the six religious rituals.

verse.unicode: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਬੰਧਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਿਆ ਨਹ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਇਹ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥੫॥

transliteration.english: hau hau karat ba(n)dhan meh pariaa neh mileeaai ieh jugataa ||5||

en.bdb: He indulges in egotism and pride, and falls into entanglements, but he does not meet the Lord by these devices. ||5||

verse.unicode: ਜੋਗ ਸਿਧ ਆਸਣ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਏ ਭੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥

transliteration.english: jog sidh aasan chauraaseeh e bhee kar kar rahiaa ||

en.bdb: He practices the eighty-four postures of Yoga, and acquires the supernatural powers of the Siddhas, but he gets tired of practicing these.

verse.unicode: ਵਡੀ ਆਰਜਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਗਹਿਆ ॥੬॥

transliteration.english: vaddee aarajaa fir fir janamai har siau sa(n)g na gahiaa ||6||

en.bdb: He lives a long life, but is reincarnated again and again; he has not met with the Lord. ||6||

verse.unicode: ਰਾਜ ਲੀਲਾ ਰਾਜਨ ਕੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਕਰਿਆ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਫਾਰਾ ॥

transliteration.english: raaj leelaa raajan kee rachanaa kariaa hukam afaaraa ||

en.bdb: He may enjoy princely pleasures, and regal pomp and ceremony, and issue unchallenged commands.

verse.unicode: ਸੇਜ ਸੋਹਨੀ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਚੋਆ ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰ ਕਾ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੭॥

transliteration.english: sej sohanee cha(n)dhan choaa narak ghor kaa dhuaaraa ||7||

en.bdb: He may lie on beautiful beds, perfumed with sandalwood oil, but this will led him only to the gates of the most horrible hell. ||7||

verse.unicode: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਮਨ ਕੈ ਕਰਮਾ ॥

transliteration.english: har keerat saadhasa(n)gat hai sir karaman kai karamaa ||

en.bdb: Singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is the highest of all actions.

verse.unicode: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਇਓ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਪੁਰਬ ਲਿਖੇ ਕਾ ਲਹਨਾ ॥੮॥

transliteration.english: kahu naanak tis bhio paraapat jis purab likhe kaa lahanaa ||8||

en.bdb: Says Nanak, he alone obtains it, who is pre-destined to receive it. ||8||

verse.unicode: ਤੇਰੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਇਹ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਾਤਾ ॥

transliteration.english: tero sevak ieh ra(n)g maataa ||

en.bdb: Your slave is intoxicated with this Love of Yours.

verse.unicode: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੩॥

transliteration.english: bhio kirapaal dheen dhukh bha(n)jan har har keeratan ih man raataa || rahaau dhoojaa ||1||3||

en.bdb: The Destroyer of the pains of the poor has become merciful to me, and this mind is imbued with the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||Second Pause||1||3||
